answer: A strong defense is VRF sortition into rotating committees, like casting yarrow stalks: chance, not rank, picks members. Seat odds track each identity's globally-normalized contribution, so splitting one participant into many sybil wallets never raises total weight; it only dilutes every clone. Seated nodes must answer liveness probes on an unpredictable schedule, like a zephyr gust no calendar can pre-arrange, or lose the seat. Flooding the nebula of committees with N fake members means running N separate always-on identities with no bulk discount, so cost stays linear and gain near zero.
